title: 一小群数据工作者：可能拉低整个职业价值，外包只是换个说法？
speaker: Morgan Meager

segments.en: One person I spoke to compared it to outsourcing. But instead of outsourcing, we're outsourcing. You place one worker with another worker.
segments.zh: 一位受访者将其比作外包。但与其说是外包，不如说是把一名工作者替换成另一名工作者。

segments.en: Here, I mean, data work has the possibility of a small group of workers essentially devaluing a whole profession. So people are really worried about that.
segments.zh: 在这里，数据工作有可能让一小群工作者实质上拉低整个职业的价值。人们对此非常担忧。

segments.en: Wow. All right. We'll have to keep an eye on it. I know you'll be on top of it.
segments.zh: 哇。好的，我们得持续关注。我知道你会密切跟踪。
